title: feat(spec): an email field declares itself a correspondent address for inbound mail (FieldSchema.mailAssociation)
body:
Part of #22870
Clause-②: yes (widening)

PR 1 of 2 on #22870, as ruled in `6116489638` (Q1 → A) and built from the stage-0 report `6115941082` §3.3, §3.5 and §4. PR 2 (`packages/services/service-mailbox`: the three objects, both read gates, `manage_mailboxes` and the `mailbox` token) stays on the card, so #22870 remains open after this lands. The key's runtime reader is the sibling ingest card #22871, which is `Blocked-by: #22870`.

## The ruling executed (verbatim, not re-ruled)

> **Q1 → A. The seam is a declared field-level key.** `FieldSchema.mailAssociation: true`, valid only on `type: 'email'` and refused at parse on any other type (the `referenceVia` refine's shape). Input: the participant set (normalised addr-specs from From, Sender, Reply-To, To and Cc, plus Q3's forwarded-part headers, minus the mailbox's own addresses), scoped to the mailbox's organisation. Output: `{ object, recordId, matchedField, matchedAddress }` rows, which become `sys_mail_association` links; an empty set means the pool. The platform learns which fields carry a correspondent address and never what a contact is. No published resolver contract in phase 1.

The card's constraint, verbatim: "Declared = enforced. Every key this card adds must get its runtime reader in the sibling ingest card, or it is not added. Liveness rows start `planned` and leave it when the reader lands."

## What

| Surface | Change |
|:--|:--|
| `FieldSchema` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`) | `mailAssociation: z.boolean().optional()` beside `referenceVia`. The TSDoc and the describe state the input, the output, the organization scope and the one legal type. No default, so `undefined` always means "not authored". |
| The parse door | `FieldSchema`'s `superRefine`, right after the two `referenceVia` checks. On any type but `email` the key (TRUE or FALSE) gets one `custom` issue at `[mailAssociation]`. The message names the field's type and the remedy: change the type to `email`, or drop the key. |
| Studio | `field.form.ts`: one row, "Match Inbound Mail", `visibleWhen: "data.type == 'email'"`. This is a parse gate, so the row shows exactly where the key parses. The help text says where the key takes effect ("only where a mailbox service is set up"), not when. The zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES leaves are hand-authored. |
| Liveness | `liveness/field.json`: `planned`, `authorWarn: true`, `authorHint` "Keep it: no mailbox service reads this yet; it takes effect when the mailbox capability ships." The note names the flip condition: the row goes `live` when the #22871 ingest lands, citing its matcher, and drops `authorWarn` / `authorHint` in the same edit. |
| Changeset | `.changeset/22870-field-mail-association.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`; `@objectstack/driver-sql`, `@objectstack/metadata-core` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` `patch` (added in the patch round, seat order 6117707461). |

Nothing outside `packages/spec` reads the key yet. No object, gate, capability name or capability token is added; those belong to PR 2.

## Declared = enforced

| Half | Where | State after this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Parse (authoring) | `FieldSchema` superRefine | Enforced: refused off `email` |
| Author warning | `@objectstack/lint` `liveness-planned-property`, at `objectstack validate` / `objectstack lint` and the metadata save door | Live: an authored `mailAssociation: true` warns with the `authorHint` |
| Runtime reader | Mailbox service ingest and re-match (#22871) | Not yet. The row is `planned` until that reader lands |

## Mechanism assumptions, measured at `origin/main` `018b077fb`

1. **Holds.** `git grep -c mailAssociation -- packages` answers 0 hits (exit 1). Control: `git grep -c referenceVia -- packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` answers 12.
2. **Holds.** The `referenceVia` type check sits at `field.zod.ts:2173`–`:2200`, inside `FieldSchema`'s `superRefine`. The pin `expect([...authorWarnedProperties('field')]).toEqual(['conditionalRequired'])` sits at `lint-liveness-properties.test.ts:1624`.
3. **Holds.** `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` gains no site. `data/Field` already carries the root site `""`, the file is unchanged, and `check:authorable-surface` is green.
4. **Partly holds.** These generated shards moved: `authorable-surface/data.json` (+1 line, written by the spec build), `content/docs/references/data/field.mdx`, `.../data/object.mdx` and `.../system/migration.mdx` (from `gen:docs`), and `liveness/state-counts/field.md` (from `gen:liveness-counts`). The predicted `json-schema.manifest/` shards did **not** move. After regeneration `check:generated` answers "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
5. **Holds.** No gate demanded a governed surface. Five non-governed classification ratchets did, listed in the next section.

## Files beyond the claim's declared surface (each demanded by a pin; none governed)

The claim fenced `field.zod.ts`, `field.form.ts`, one new spec test, `liveness/field.json`, the `authorWarnedProperties('field')` pin, the generated artifacts and one changeset. A new `FieldSchema` key and a new form row are also counted by the ratchets below, and each one is red until the key is classified. The `dueLike` precedent (215e66204) paid the same set.

- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/builtin-column-collision.ts`: `FIELD_KEY_STORAGE_CLASS` is pinned against `FieldSchema.shape`. The new entry is `mailAssociation: 'presentation'`.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls-references.ts`: `FIELD_REFERENCE_POSITIONS` is pinned against `FieldSchema.shape`. The new entry is `keep`, because the key is a boolean that names no field.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts`: the served `field` property count moves 78 → 79.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-predicate-path-refs.test.ts`: the shipped-form predicate census moves 87 → 88, and the literal-comparison census moves 64 → 65.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`: the row's label and help text, in en plus three hand-authored locales. In `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`, the translated-label control moves 669 → 670.

Neither classification table changes runtime behaviour for a boolean. An unclassified key was already silent in driver-sql, and the FLS scrub already passed a boolean through. The changeset first named `@objectstack/spec` alone, as the precedent's did; the patch round (seat order 6117707461) added a `patch` entry for each of the three touched published packages, because every touched published package names itself in a changeset.

## Tests (HEAD `52bcc8429`)

- **New spec test** `packages/spec/src/data/field-mail-association.test.ts` (16 cases):
  - Accepted on `email` (TRUE and FALSE, full `safeParse` green), and no default materializes.
  - A non-boolean is `invalid_type`.
  - Refused on `text`, `url`, `phone`, `textarea`, `lookup`, `formula`, `number` and `boolean`. Each case gets exactly one `custom` issue at path `['mailAssociation']`, naming `type: 'email'` and the offending type.
  - An off-type `false` is refused.
  - Positive control: the refusal is the only issue on the text fixture, and the same fixture without the key parses.
  - The JSON-schema projection carries an optional `boolean` `mailAssociation`.
  - The form offers exactly one row, gated `data.type == 'email'`.
- **Ablation** (committed state, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with a `trap` restore):
  - The refusal condition was mutated to `if (false && field.mailAssociation …`, and the tool reported the anchor 1 → 0, blob `2a3049530` → `a290fcd02`.
  - Result: **10 failed | 6 passed (16)**. Every refusal case went red; the accept, projection and form cases stayed green.
  - Restore: blob back to the HEAD blob `2a30495308c6` and `git diff HEAD` empty, both from the tool and from the trap's own `git hash-object` comparison.
  - The test imports `./field.zod` from source, so no dist sits on the path.
- **`@objectstack/spec`**, rebuilt at `52bcc8429`: the full suite `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` passed 649 files / 19410 tests (1 todo), and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exits 0.
- **Downstream suites**, each on a freshly built dependency closure (`pnpm --filter 'PKG^...' build` for the five packages):
  - `@objectstack/lint`: full suite, 137 files / 6529 tests passed.
  - `@objectstack/metadata-core`: full suite, 17 / 386 passed.
  - `@objectstack/platform-objects`: full suite, 69 / 1083 passed.
  - `@objectstack/driver-sql`: `builtin-column-collision.test.ts`, 11 passed.
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: `protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts`, 18 passed.
  - `typecheck` exits 0 on all five.
- **ESLint, narrowed to the 13 changed TS files** (`eslint --no-inline-config --format json`): 13 files linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
  - The population is `eslint.config.mjs`'s `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}']`; no changed file is ignored.
  - The config never enables type-aware linting (`eslint.config.mjs`: "no `parserOptions.project`, no typed `@typescript-eslint` rules"), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
  - The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derived 114 commands at merge base `018b077fb`. Each one was run with its exit code recorded before any pipe, then reconciled with `--ran`: **114 derived, 112 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.**

- `pnpm check:i18n` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET. It was re-run after building its stated prerequisite closure, and answered "all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys" for 9 packages. That makes the hand-authored locale leaves byte-identical to the extractor's output, with the `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` files untouched. `check:lean-entry-closure` likewise went exit 3 → exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:skill-examples`. Reason: the client SDK packages are not built with declarations, and this diff touches no skill or example.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. Reason: it needs every package built with declarations, while the local i18n prerequisite build was JS-only.
- `check:platform-checklist` exits 1 with 8 ABSENT SYMBOL / ANCHORS LOST problems in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`. The control run on a detached `018b077fb` checkout answers the identical 8, so this is not this diff. The gate is kept out of per-PR CI by `checklist-status.yml`'s own note.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`'s `field` cell still says the type "carries NO `authorWarn` row at any depth". That was already untrue before this PR (`conditionalRequired`'s `dead` row has warned on its own since the verdict-warns ruling), and it is further from true now. Prose only; no gate reads it. Carrier: none.
- `lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`'s "field walk: a malformed `fields` array …" block could take `mailAssociation` as a real subject. It is not re-subjected here because a `planned` row is scheduled to flip `live`, which is exactly the subject loss that block's neighbour exists to survive.
- No hand-written docs page (`content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`) is added. The reference page carries the describe, and a narrative page belongs with the reader, so no page advertises a capability that nothing delivers yet.

## Review

`Clause-②: yes (widening)` on `packages/spec`, so a review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed before landing. No governed surface is in the file list.
